us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump leaves for Asia amid domestic political pressure
bullets: Trump is set to visit Manila and Shenzhen this week.
The trip follows Republican losses in the November midterm elections.
The White House says economic deals and nuclear talks are central aims.

articles.title: AAA forecasts another busy Thanksgiving travel week
bullets: AAA expects heavy holiday travel around Thanksgiving week.
Last year’s shutdown-related FAA flight cuts disrupted many passengers.
Airlines and airports are preparing for another high-volume period.

articles.title: Senate Democrat signals scrutiny of Commerce Secretary Lutnick
bullets: The Senate Commerce Committee’s top Democrat flagged future oversight.
Lutnick is traveling with Trump on the Asia trip.
Democrats are preparing investigations after winning Congress.

articles.title: Trump administration faces questions over air-traffic funding request
bullets: The administration is seeking $50 billion for air-traffic control upgrades.
Democrats want answers on prior aviation infrastructure spending.
Recent router problems reportedly contributed to a nationwide grounding.

articles.title: Pentagon faces criticism over Iran drone-warning handling
bullets: A report says officials were warned about Iran’s drone capabilities.
The issue follows years of drone warfare lessons from Ukraine.
U.S. drone-defense preparedness is under renewed scrutiny.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: U.S., China and Russia prepare rare three-way nuclear talks
bullets: Trump’s Asia trip includes planned talks with Xi and Putin.
China called the trilateral discussions potentially groundbreaking.
The meetings are expected to address global security stability.

articles.title: UN-backed talks weigh rules for lethal autonomous weapons
bullets: Government envoys are meeting in Geneva this week.
The talks focus on killer robots and autonomous drones.
Delegates may decide whether to launch formal rule negotiations.

articles.title: Ethiopia and Sudan trade accusations as conflict fears rise
bullets: Both governments accuse the other of backing armed fighters.
Sudan filed complaints against Ethiopia with the United Nations.
Analysts warn instability could spread across both countries.

articles.title: South Africa mass shootings kill at least 17 people
bullets: Police reported two mass shootings on the same day.
At least 17 people were killed in the attacks.
Authorities were alerted on the morning of November 16.

articles.title: Houthis accuse Saudi Arabia of deadly strikes in Yemen
bullets: Houthis said Saudi strikes killed three people, including a child.
The report came amid wider Middle East tensions.
AP also reported related regional political and security developments.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Modi heads to Manila for ASEAN and East Asia summits
bullets: Modi departed for meetings in the Philippines.
India says ASEAN ties anchor its Act East Policy.
Trade, maritime security and regional connectivity are expected topics.

articles.title: Deep depression likely to intensify into Cyclone Akvan
bullets: IMD expects a Bay of Bengal system to strengthen.
Andhra Pradesh has been placed on alert.
Fishermen were warned against venturing into rough seas.

articles.title: Congress seeks new Supreme Court-monitored Ram Temple donation probe
bullets: Jairam Ramesh called for a fresh investigation.
The demand concerns alleged Ram Temple donation theft.
Congress wants a probe reporting exclusively to the Supreme Court.

articles.title: RBI seeks Supreme Court review of Yes Bank bond order
bullets: RBI asked the Supreme Court to review a Yes Bank judgment.
The case concerns ₹84.15 billion in AT1 bonds.
The court had set aside the bond write-off last month.

articles.title: NIA arrests another accused in Mizoram methamphetamine seizure case
bullets: NIA arrested a suspect from Assam’s Silchar.
The case involves 236.33 kg of methamphetamine tablets.
Officials valued the seizure at about ₹30.72 crore.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top U.S. market movers and market-moving themes

articles.title: Tech futures slip before Nvidia earnings and Anthropic debut
bullets: Nasdaq 100 futures fell more than broader index futures.
Investors are watching Nvidia’s November 17 results.
Anthropic’s expected market debut is also in focus.

articles.title: Retail traders return to buying the stock-market dip
bullets: Axios reported dip-buying interest is returning.
Single-stock options remain popular with retail traders.
Nvidia remains a key focus for speculative positioning.

articles.title: Nvidia selloff continues to shape broader tech trading
bullets: Reuters said tech remains under pressure entering the week.
Nvidia has lost major value over six weeks.
Markets are also watching potential chip-export restrictions.

articles.title: Cloudflare jumps after beat-and-raise results
bullets: StreetInsider reported Cloudflare surged in after-hours trading.
The move followed stronger-than-expected results and guidance.
Cloud software names remain active market movers.

articles.title: Polibeli Group jumps after AI computing-services agreement
bullets: DailyHub listed Polibeli as stock of the day.
Shares rose after an AI computing services deal.
The customer was described as Taiwan-based.

articles.title: Diesel prices fall below $6 for first time since September
bullets: AAA data showed average diesel prices below $6 per gallon.
Axios linked the decline to lower recent oil prices.
Fuel costs remain important for transport and logistics firms.

articles.title: U.S. oilfield consolidation continues with $5 billion deal
bullets: Axios reported a $5 billion cash-and-stock energy transaction.
The deal adds to Permian-focused consolidation.
Energy finance remains active despite oil-market volatility.

articles.title: Building-materials startup Supersede raises $13 million
bullets: Supersede raised a Series A led by APV Ventures.
The company plans to expand manufacturing capacity.
It is targeting broader industrial use of its materials.

articles.title: India’s wholesale inflation quickens to 12.29% in October
bullets: Government data showed wholesale inflation rose year over year.
Higher food and oil prices drove the increase.
The reading adds pressure before budget consultations.

articles.title: Sitharaman begins pre-budget consultations for 2027–28 budget
bullets: India’s finance minister began consultations with economists.
The talks are part of Budget 2027–28 preparations.
Economic growth, inflation and fiscal priorities are likely central issues.

articles.title: Nvidia results and Anthropic IPO set up pivotal AI week
bullets: Reuters called it a telling week for technology markets.
Nvidia reports results on November 17.
Anthropic’s listing is expected later in the week.

articles.title: Microsoft 365 and Teams outage affects millions worldwide
bullets: Users reported disruptions to Outlook, Teams and Microsoft 365.
Tom’s Guide cited estimates of hundreds of millions affected.
Analysts warned some businesses could face economic losses.

articles.title: Shenzhen showcases China’s technology ambitions during APEC week
bullets: AP described Shenzhen as a window into China’s tech transformation.
The city is hosting major APEC-related activity.
Tech and trade tensions frame the summit backdrop.
articles.source: Associated Press via Metro News Channel Nebraska

articles.title: Mphasis says clients are increasing cybersecurity spending
bullets: Mphasis reported stronger cybersecurity demand from clients.
The company cited AI-driven threats as a factor.
The update came in Reuters’ India technology coverage.

articles.title: Tacoma Power uses satellite-fed AI forecasts for hydropower
bullets: Axios reported Tacoma Power uses Upstream Tech’s HydroForecast.
The system combines NASA satellite, weather and river data.
Forecasts are updated every two hours.
